@ithompson4 yes we would love an open PR - even one that is a work in progress is fine. Check out our [contributing doc](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md) and ask us if you get stuck.

@jennifer-shehane 
i saw the querying.coffee file.
here have some codes :
```js
_.defaults(options, {
        retry: true
        withinSubject: cy.state("withinSubject")
        log: true
        command: null
        verify: true
      })
```

it allows you can pass a options.log to control options._log initialization

```js
return if options.log is false
options._log ?= Cypress.log
          message: selector
          referencesAlias: if aliasObj?.alias then {name: aliasObj.alias}
          aliasType: aliasType
          consoleProps: -> consoleProps
```

the code looks like allow log: false to happen.

maybe just use options._log.error when options.log is true

when options.log is false just return error object

issue.title: fix: #3847 only options.log !== false use options._log.error

issue.body:
close #3847 

i saw the querying.coffee file.
here have some codes :

```js
_.defaults(options, {
  retry: true
  withinSubject: cy.state("withinSubject")
  log: true
  command: null
  verify: true
})
```

it allows you can pass a `options.log` to control `options._log` initialization

```js
return if options.log is false

options._log ?= Cypress.log
  message: selector
  referencesAlias: if aliasObj?.alias then {name: aliasObj.alias}
  aliasType: aliasType
  consoleProps: -> consoleProps
```
the code looks like allow `log: false` to happen.

maybe just use `options._log.error` when `options.log` is `true`

when `options.log` is `false` just return error object

change like this
```js
e.onFail = -> if options.log is false then e else options._log.error(e)
```
